name: EPA technology overview: circulating fluidized-bed combustion
notes: Page read 2026-11-24 with WebFetch during the gas-fired boiler sweep. Historical EPA-funded CFB overview: 10-30 ft/s CFB fluidising velocity versus 2-12 ft/s conventional FBC, 50-300 µm versus 1,000-1,200 µm bed particles; a Lurgi circulating fluid bed alumina calciner achieved 40 ppm NOx on natural gas (not a boiler); Pihlava PYROFLOW retrofit commercial April 1979. Evidence: https://nepis.epa.gov/Exe/ZyPURL.cgi?Dockey=9100RMKB.TXT
